t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Brown Red and pink gnomes bring up one type of basket - keep going with that until the mushrooms decrease. Green blue and yellow gnomes bring up a yellow basket - when the mushrooms decrease from the earlier basket, switch to the yellow and again when it further decreases.

vb_textbox.text: I got some advice before playing which was to choose gnomes that led to one colour basket (see below) until the mushroom numbers started to reduce, then switch to the other basket colour. I don't think it worked but you might have some luck with it. Personally, I don't think anything you do matters, but here's what I did: After trying some stuff out, I then stuck to the gnome colours that led me to the red basket: Brown, pink, red, purple etc, and avoided yellows oranges blues and greens. This seemed to keep me on a stable average, but again - I could just be putting order on a random game. I'd say experiment in the first few rounds, trust your gut and go with what seems right - if you can't find a pattern, just go with whatever gnome feels right to you.
